items.title: 米当局が銀行に脆弱性確認、バイナンスハッキング受け＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Stephen Gandel　Nupur Anand

[ニューヨーク ５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Stephen Gandel　Nupur Anand

[ニューヨーク ５日 ロイター] - 米規制当局は暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換所バイナンスで先週、６３億ドル規模のハッキング被害が発生したことを受け、銀行に連絡を取りシステムに脆弱性がないか確認した。関係筋が明らかにした。

仮想通貨市場と伝統的な金融の結び付きが強まる中、規制当局はハッキングの影響が銀行などに波及するリスクを警戒している。

複数の関係者によると、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）と米通貨監督庁（ＯＣＣ）の監督担当者は２日朝から銀行に連絡し、異常な動きやサービスの障害がないか聞き取りを行った。

規制当局から連絡を受けた銀行の関係者は、自行のサービスに障害はないと述べた。顧客対応に備えて行内で説明事項をまとめたものの、その後の問い合わせはほとんどないと話した。

別の関係者２人によると、銀行は史上最大の金融窃盗事件とみられる今回のバイナンスへのハッキングを分析している。同様の攻撃を防げるよう自行のシステムの診断も進めている。

関係者の１人によると、米最大手行の１行では、攻撃から数時間以内にサイバーセキュリティー担当チームがバイナンスの担当者と連絡を取った。同チームは内部報告書をまとめており、報告書を基に自行のシステムを見直し、サイバーセキュリティー対策を更新する可能性もある。

バイナンスは、銀行と規制当局のやり取りについて把握しておらず、今回のハッキングが米銀に影響を及ぼしたかどうかも分からないとした。同社の広報担当者は「世界各地の規制当局と緊密に連絡を取り、今回のセキュリティー侵害について最新情報を伝えている」と述べた。

ＦＲＢとＯＣＣはコメントを控えた。

関係者の１人は、人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルが急速に進化し、銀行がハッカーに対抗し続けるのが難しくなっていることが大きな懸念だと指摘した。銀行はサイバーセキュリティー関連のコードの点検や修正に多くの資源を投入しているという。

バイナンスは、銀行と規制当局のやり取りについて把握しておらず、今回のハッキングが米銀に影響を及ぼしたかどうかも分からないとした。同社の広報担当者は「世界各地の規制当局と緊密に連絡を取り、今回のセキュリティー侵害について最新情報を伝えている」と述べた。

ＦＲＢとＯＣＣはコメントを控えた。

関係者の１人は、人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルが急速に進化し、銀行がハッカーに対抗し続けるのが難しくなっていることが大きな懸念だと指摘した。銀行はサイバーセキュリティー関連のコードの点検や修正に多くの資源を投入しているという。

items.title: Paraguay President Santiago Pena resigns following bank collapse
items.summary: Paraguay's President Santiago Pena resigned after regulators seized Ueno Bank over risky lending, triggering protests, depositor panic and an impeachment debate.
items.body:
Home / World News / Paraguay President Santiago Pena resigns following bank collapse

Paraguay President Santiago Pena resigns following bank collapse Paraguay's President Santiago Pena resigned after regulators seized Ueno Bank over risky lending, triggering protests, depositor panic and an impeachment debate.

Paraguayan President Santiago Pena | Image: Reuters

Press Trust of India 6 min read Last Updated : Nov 06 2026 | 12:31 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Paraguayan President Santiago Pena resigned Thursday, days after the nation's central bank seized Ueno Bank, a major digital lender with close ties to his government.
  Pena announced his resignation in a video posted to X, saying he was stepping down to preserve the country's stability and democratic institutions as massive protests rocked the capital, Asuncion, for a third day and lawmakers debated the president's impeachment.
  "I have made the decision to submit my resignation as president of the republic," said Pena, a one-time investor in a company related to Ueno Bank. "I do so thinking of the stability of our country, social peace and the need to preserve our democratic institutions."
 

  Pena offered an apology but stopped short of accepting responsibility for the banking crisis.
  "I also want to apologize to the people if I have failed them at any point," he said. "It was never my intention to betray the trust they placed in me."
Also Read

Bandhan Bank reports ₹622 cr net profit in Q2, gross NPA at 3.11%

  He said his priority was ensuring depositors recovered their savings.
  "Behind every deposit are years of hard work, sacrifice and family dreams," he said.
  Ueno Bank, a major digital lender, went from an obscure finance company to a household name in less than five years, claimed more than 60% of Paraguay's adults as customers.
  The political upheaval and promises of relief leave a bigger question unanswered: how a bank linked to the president, who until last year had a stake in Ueno's holding company, could grow so rapidly in size and importance despite repeated warnings about its dubious lending practices.

  For many Paraguayans, the answer lies in the uncomfortable proximity of Pena's long-ruling Colorado Party to the country's regulators and business elite, a weakness that has endured even as steady economic management and rapid growth made Paraguay a darling of international investors in recent years.
  "Santiago Pena and the Colorado Party have stolen all our savings," said Luis Pineda, one of the protesters marching to Congress on Wednesday. "We are fed up with 70 years of plunder."
  Soon after winning its banking license in 2023, Ueno seemed to be everywhere in Paraguay. The digital lender, a rebranded version of a decades-old finance company, lured customers with generous cash-back offers on groceries, grew to more than 70 locations, sponsored Paraguay's national soccer team and plastered its name on the country's main stadium.

  Government money poured into Ueno's coffers under Pena. He also appointed Carlos Carvallo, president of Financiera Ueno, the predecessor to Ueno Bank, to run the central bank, the agency charged with supervising the digital lender.
  As of last month, Ueno reported holding roughly $800 million in public deposits, about a quarter of its total, including money from the state pension and health fund and the operators of Paraguay's giant hydroelectric dams.
  Even as retirees' savings and other public money piled up at Ueno, worries were escalating inside the central bank. In June, its inspectors found a pattern of risky lending to insiders, reported ABC Colour, a leading Paraguayan newspaper.

  Ueno had extended large sums to companies tied to its owners, beyond what the law allows and without enough collateral to cover the debts if they went bad. On a single day in September 2025, nearly $39 million had gone to three such companies.
  Pena repeatedly brushed off the warnings. As recently as last month, he defended Ueno and the central bank's oversight, dismissing the concerns as a smear campaign that was spooking the public.
  But on Monday, it all came crashing down. Regulators investigating Ueno's loans to companies linked to its owners found poorly documented lending, the central bank said, as well as expenses the bank had wrongly counted as assets.

  Once the books were corrected, Ueno's capital, the cushion banks must keep to absorb losses, fell to less than half the legal minimum. The central bank seized the lender Tuesday and announced plans to move customers' accounts, along with whatever assets still hold value, to other banks before liquidating what's left.
  Ueno's app, cards and transfers went dark and its branches locked their doors, leaving desperate depositors lined up outside with no way to cash out their savings. On Wednesday, a rush to open new accounts elsewhere crashed other banks' mobile apps, fuelling public panic.
  Officials appealed for calm and said they had begun repaying depositors, opening new accounts elsewhere for about 280,000 who had banked only with Ueno.

  "The banking system is sound," insisted Pedro Acosta Bernal, appointed interim central bank president Wednesday after Carvallo resigned at Pena's request.
  Authorities have detained eight senior Ueno executives, including founder Miguel Vazquez and bank President Juan Manuel Gustale. Prosecutors also charged 27 bank officials and business associates with offenses including breach of trust and attempted fraud.
  Lawyers for several of the detained said they needed time to review the allegations before they could comment.
  Hundreds of employees of Ueno Bank and other companies belonging to Grupo Vazquez, the bank's parent conglomerate, protested outside the Labor Ministry on Thursday, demanding severance and unpaid wages with their jobs in limbo and their salaries trapped at the failed bank.

  A day earlier, hundreds of retirees, depositors, university students and workers flooded the streets of Asuncion, the capital.
  "We want your head, Pena!" they shouted. Their signs demanded Pena's impeachment, called him "the enemy of savers" and pleaded "Give us back our money."
  Riot police fired pepper spray and rubber pellets to push back the crowds.
  Many demonstrators saw Ueno's collapse not just as the result of risky banking but as a case study in official corruption. Only Venezuela ranks worse in South America on the latest index of perceived corruption from Transparency International, a global watchdog.
  "This is yet another assault on honest, hard-working citizens, people whose small savings are the fruit of years of labour," said protester Belarmino Balbuena.

  At the national stadium that once bore Ueno's name, the bank's logo had already been scrubbed away. But across the capital, fresh graffiti denounced politicians as thieves.

items.body:
エールフランスＫＬＭ、利益が予想上回る　ＫＬＭは大規模再編へ
11/5 19:56 配信

エールフランスＫＬＭのロゴ、パリの同社ビルで2023年撮影 REUTERS/Benoit Tessier（ロイター） Joanna Plucinska　Gianluca Lo Nostro

[ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - 欧州航空大手エールフランスＫＬＭが５日発表した第３・四半期決算は、営業利益が市場予想を上回った。オランダ事業のＫＬＭは、年間利益を１０億ユーロ（１１億ドル）改善することを目指す大規模な再編計画を公表した。

ＫＬＭは収益性を改善し、新型機への投資資金を確保するために、今後数年間で従業員数をさらに１５％近く減らすと明らかにした。約４０００人分の業務を機内食会社などのパートナーに外部委託する。また生産性向上に向けて約１０００人を削減する。

エールフランスＫＬＭの株価は、パリ市場の序盤の取引で約１３％上昇した。

エールフランスＫＬＭの第３・四半期の営業利益は１３億４０００万ユーロとなり、同社がまとめたアナリスト予想の１１億ユーロを上回った。

アジアへの直行便の需要が旺盛だったことや、拡充を進めるプレミアム旅行サービスが好調だった。

一方、２０２６年の輸送能力の伸び率見通しを従来の２─３％から２％に引き下げた。２６年の燃料費見通しは８９億ドルから９２億ドルに引き上げた。

[香港 ５日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は上昇して引けた。米中間選挙を受けセンチメント...
items.body:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝香港3.7％高で21カ月ぶり大幅上昇、中国は小幅高
11/5 19:52 配信

Summer Zhen

[香港 ５日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は上昇して引けた。米中間選挙を受けセンチメントが回復し、香港株は２１カ月ぶりの大幅高となった。中国株は小幅に上昇した。

香港のハンセン指数は３．７％高で終了。２０２５年２月以来の大幅な上昇率を記録した。

ハンセンテック指数は５．６％急伸。指数への影響が大きいアリババとテンセントは、それぞれ８％超、７％超上昇した。

米中間選挙後の不透明感の後退が好感され、前日の米株高に追随した。

モーニングスターのアナリストは５日公表の投資見通しで「中国と香港は引き続き相対的に魅力がある」と指摘した。１０月の調整局面では、ハンセン指数が５％、ＣＳＩ３００指数が９％下落していた。

同社のアジア株式調査ディレクター、ロレイン・タン氏は、ファンダメンタルズの悪化ではなく、人工知能（ＡＩ）への懸念から大きく売られた優良銘柄には、今回の調整が反発の機会をもたらす可能性もあると述べた。同社はアリババとテンセントに強気の見方を示している。

珠海華発集団が地元政府から資金支援を受けたことを受け、不動産株が反発したことも相場を支えた。

中国本土Ａ株市場では、ＣＳＩ３００指数が０．３％高、上海総合指数が０．１％高で終了した。

業種別では、太陽光発電株、半導体株、新エネルギー株が買われた。一方、石油株と光通信株は売られた。

ＣＣＢインターナショナルのチーフエコノミスト、クリフ・チャオ氏は、民主党が米中間選挙で圧勝した後も、先端技術を巡る米中の競争は続くと予想。民主党が商務省の輸出許可に対する議会の監視を強化し、関連する規制法案を推進する可能性があるとした。

同氏は「中国国内の技術サプライチェーンでは、明暗がさらに分かれる可能性がある」と指摘。米国のＡＩ設備投資に大きく依存するハードウエア輸出企業は影響を受ける可能性がある一方、画像処理半導体（ＧＰＵ）、半導体製造装置、先端パッケージング、計算インフラは、技術自立の必要性から引き続き恩恵を受ける可能性があると述べた。

国有石油大手ペトロチャイナは８％下落した。民主党の勝利で米国とイランの戦争終結への期待が高まり、原油価格が下落したことが圧迫した。

深セン総合指数は１．６％高。深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は０．９％高、上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は１．７％高となった。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:
Nerijus Adomaitis　Terje Solsvik

[オスロ ５日 ロイター] - ノルウェー中央銀行は５...
items.body:
ノルウェー中銀、金利据え置き　追加利上げの可能性示唆
11/5 19:23 配信

オスロのノルウェー中央銀行、2023年撮影 REUTERS/Victoria Klesty（ロイター） Nerijus Adomaitis　Terje Solsvik

[オスロ ５日 ロイター] - ノルウェー中央銀行は５日、政策金利を４．５０％に据え置いた。インフレを抑えるため、追加利上げの可能性があると改めて表明した。ロイターが調査したエコノミスト全員が据え置きを予想していた。

バーチェ総裁は声明で「政策金利を当面、高水準に維持する必要があるだろう。妥当な期間内にインフレ率を目標まで引き下げるため、必要であれば利上げする用意がある」と述べた。

ノルウェークローネは０９１７ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後６時１７分）時点で１ユーロ＝１０．４４クローネと、発表直前の１０．４３クローネから小幅に下落した。

中銀は中東の紛争が引き続きインフレ見通しに大きな不確実性をもたらしており、今後の政策金利は経済の動向次第だとした。

声明で「委員会は９月の金融政策会合以降、ノルウェー経済の見通しが大きく変わったことを示す情報を得ていない」とした。中銀は９月、政策金利を２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げた。

＜インフレ率、目標の２％を上回る＞

ノルウェーの９月のコアインフレ率は前年同月比３．０％と、中銀が目標とする２％程度を上回った。このため金利が高水準で維持されるとの見方が強まっている。

中銀は政策審議で、クローネが９月以降に想定以上に上昇し、今後はインフレを抑える方向に働くと指摘した。一方、エネルギー価格が想定を上回り、インフレを押し上げているとした。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jacob Gronholt-Pedersen　Stine Jacobsen

［コペンハーゲン　５日　ロイター］ - ...
items.body:
海運マースク、通期利益予想3回目上方修正　運賃高止まりが押し上げ
11/5 19:15 配信

2026年3月10日、米カリフォルニア州のロサンゼルス港に停泊中のマースク社の船舶に積まれるコンテナ。 REUTERS/Caroline Brehman/File Photo（ロイター） Jacob Gronholt-Pedersen　Stine Jacobsen

［コペンハーゲン　５日　ロイター］ - デンマークの海運大手マースクは５日、２０２６年通期利益予想について３度目の上方修正をした。人工知能（ＡＩ）主導の需要を背景にコンテナ船運賃が高止まりしていることを反映した。ただ、第３・四半期利益は市場予想を下回った。

利益予想の引き上げは貨物量の増加によるものではなく運賃上昇が主因で、中東情勢を背景とする航路の混乱や港湾の滞船といった一時的な要因に支えられている側面が強い。 アナリストからは、船舶のスエズ運河通航再開や新造船の投入に伴い、こうした混乱は薄れるとの見方も聞かれる。

マースクは、２６年通期の実質利払い・税・償却前利益（ＥＢＩＴＤＡ）予想を、従来の１０５億─１２５億ドルから１４０億─１４５億ドルに引き上げた。

実質利払い・税引き前利益（ＥＢＩＴ）予想も、４５億─６５億ドルから８０億─８５億ドルに引き上げた。

新たなＥＢＩＴＤＡ予想は、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想（１４０億２０００万ドル）とほぼ一致した。

第３・四半期のＥＢＩＴＤＡは前年同期比７５％増の４７億ドルで、ＬＳＥＧのアナリスト予想平均である５０億４０００万ドルを下回った。

アナリストらは、海運部門の輸送量が予想を下回ったことやコスト増加が営業利益の未達につながったと指摘した。

海運部門の輸送量は前年同期とほぼ横ばいだったが、運賃は前四半期比で４６％上昇し、前年同期比では２倍以上に跳ね上がった。

ビンセント・クラーク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「地政学的な不確実性や混乱が続く中でも、世界貿易は極めて強靱（きょうじん）さを維持している」とし、「需要は個人消費だけでなく、電動化やエネルギーへの大規模投資、ＡＩインフラの急速な拡張によって、活発な産業貨物の流れが世界で生み出されている」と指摘した。

マースクは米国市場について、個人消費とＡＩ構築に伴う設備投資に支えられ、経済活動は堅調に推移したと説明した。中国の成長は内需低迷により抑制され、最近の財政政策による押し上げ効果も限定的だったとした。

今年の世界コンテナ輸送量は約４％増との予想を維持した。

items.title: Scarlett Johansson says her 'The Batman: Part II' role spurred "lot of existential angst"
items.summary: Johansson shared that her upcoming role in the Robert Pattinson-led film, stating that it has pushed her outside her comfort zone.
items.body:
Scarlett Johansson says her 'The Batman: Part II' role spurred "lot of existential angst" Johansson shared that her upcoming role in the Robert Pattinson-led film, stating that it has pushed her outside her comfort zone.
ANI | Updated: 05-11-2026 23:33 IST | Created: 05-11-2026 23:33 IST

Actor Scarlett Johansson (File photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Hollywood actor Scarlett Johansson has opened up about her role in the upcoming DC film 'The Batman: Part II'. In a recent interview, Johansson shared that her upcoming role in the Robert Pattinson-led film, stating that it has pushed her outside her comfort zone and spurred a "lot of existential angst, for some reason," as per Variety.
"It was very hard to figure out. I don’t know why, whether it was just the role or it was just where I am in my life, but it was just hard to crack it. And that’s all I can say about it," she said, as quoted by Variety. However, the 'Avengers' star refrained from sharing many details about her character. In May, Johansson's role was confirmed in an X post by director Matt Reeves, with a GIF of the actress' reflection in a car's rear-view mirror from the 2013 film 'Under the Skin'.
Meanwhile, production on the film is currently being led by director Steven Soderbergh after Reeves, who also helmed 2022's 'Batman'. "Once you get past the origin tale, which we didn’t quite do, but we did something that referred to his origins, then you start telling the Rogues Gallery story and that character’s sort of arc. But I never wanted to lose Robert Pattinson at the centre of these stories, and so that is really what we set our aim on," Reeves said in a previous interview.
Besides Pattinson and Johansson, the film features Sebastian Stan, Charles Dance, Brian Tyree Henry, Colin Farrell as the Penguin, Andy Serkis as Alfred Pennyworth, and Jeffrey Wright as Commissioner Gordon. (ANI)

items.title: RBI proposes ₹100 crore limit on bank loans for agri infrastructure
items.summary: The RBI has proposed a ₹100 crore aggregate loan limit per borrower for agricultural infrastructure under revised priority sector lending norms.
items.body:
Home / Industry / Banking / RBI proposes ₹100 crore limit on bank loans for agri infrastructure

RBI proposes ₹100 crore limit on bank loans for agri infrastructure The RBI has proposed a ₹100 crore aggregate loan limit per borrower for agricultural infrastructure under revised priority sector lending norms.

The Reserve Bank of India has proposed revised priority sector lending norms, including a ₹100 crore aggregate loan limit per borrower for agricultural infrastructure and higher eligibility limits for education and renewable energy loans. (Photo: Reuters)

Press Trust of India Mumbai 2 min read Last Updated : Nov 05 2026 | 11:16 PM IST

Listen to This Article

The Reserve Bank on Thursday proposed that loans for agricultural infrastructure will be subject to an aggregate sanctioned limit of Rs 100 crore per borrower from the banking system.
As part of the ongoing effort towards consolidation of various instructions, the Reserve Bank of India said it has undertaken a review of the extant guidelines relating to Priority Sector Lending (PSL) and proposes to issue directions on the subject for different regulated entities, including commercial banks and regional rural banks.
A draft direction on commercial banks proposed an aggregate loan limit of Rs 4 crore per borrowing entity for crop loans, medium and long-term loans for agriculture and allied activities, as well as loans for pre- and post-harvest activities.
  It also said: "Loans for agriculture infrastructure will be subject to an aggregate sanctioned limit of Rs 100 crore per borrower from the banking system."   The lending to the agriculture sector will include farm credit (agriculture and allied activities), lending for agriculture infrastructure and ancillary activities.
The draft further said that loans to individuals for educational purposes, including vocational courses, not exceeding Rs 25 lakh, will be considered as eligible for priority sector classification.
Also Read

Regarding renewable energy, it said bank loans up to a limit of Rs 35 crore to borrowers for renewable energy-based power generators and for renewable energy-based public utilities -- street lighting systems, remote village electrification -- will be eligible for priority sector classification.
For individual households, the loan limit will be Rs 10 lakh per borrower, the draft said.
Agriculture, MSMEs, exports, education, housing, social infrastructure, and renewable energy are among the categories under the priority sector.
The RBI has also issued separate draft directions for small finance banks, local area banks, and regional rural banks. RBI has invited comments and feedback on the drafts by November 26.

items.body:
マレーシア中銀、8会合連続据え置き　来年も力強い成長予想
11/5 18:41 配信

[クアラルンプール ５日 ロイター] - マレーシア中央銀行は５日、政策金利である翌日物金利を８会合連続で２．７５％に据え置いた。２０２７年も力強い経済成長が続くと予想した。

ロイター調査に回答したエコノミスト２９人の大半が現状維持を予想していた。

中銀は声明で「経済のファンダメンタルズは健全で、２７年も成長は底堅さを保つ見通しだ」とした。世界的に好調なテクノロジー分野と堅調な観光客消費に支えられ、外需が引き続き成長の主要なけん引役になると見込んだ。

一方、中東での紛争の長期化や１次産品の生産減少が成長見通しの下振れリスクになると指摘した。

中銀によると、年初来の総合インフレ率は平均１．８％、コアインフレ率は同１．９％だった。政府の補助金やその他の支援策が物価上昇の抑制に寄与したとしている。

２７年は地政学情勢や世界的な１次産品価格の上昇、悪天候がインフレを押し上げる可能性があるとした。

通貨リンギの対ドル相場は政策金利の発表後も変わらず、０．３％高の水準を維持した。

中銀は、現在の金融政策が物価安定の継続と持続可能な成長という見通しに整合していると説明した。情勢の変化を注視し、国内のインフレと成長への影響を見極める考えを示した。

ＯＣＢＣのシニアエコノミスト、ラバンヤ・ベンカテスワラン氏は、金融政策正常化の余地はなお十分にあるとの見方を示した。「成長見通しは引き続き力強く、インフレ率は２７年にかけて緩やかながら上昇すると予想される。こうした状況を踏まえ、２７年１月に２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げがあるとの従来の予想を維持する」と述べた。

items.title: New wave of bomb hoaxes hits at least 27 passenger flights across Europe
items.author: CNA
items.summary: While no country has attributed blame for the threats, they come at a time when many European officials have accused Russia of masterminding sabotage and "hybrid attacks".
items.body:
Advertisement

World

New wave of bomb hoaxes hits at least 27 passenger flights across Europe

While no country has attributed blame for the threats, they come at a time when many European officials have accused Russia of masterminding sabotage and "hybrid attacks".

An Aer Lingus Airbus A320 plane is seen at Evreux military air base after the flight from Dublin to Rome was diverted to France following a bomb threat on Nov 5, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Gonzalo Fuentes)

05 Nov 2026 05:31PM
(Updated: 06 Nov 2026 07:12AM)

FAST

PARIS: Hoax bomb threat s disrupted at least 27 passenger flights across Europe on Thursday (Nov 5), forcing unplanned landings by some planes and prompting fighter jets to escort or intercept others, in the second such wave this week.
No country has attributed blame for the threat s, which come as many European officials are accusing Russia of masterminding sabotage and "hybrid attacks" , often cheap, easily deniable and not expected to trigger an armed response.
At least seven flights and a cruise ship also received hoax threat s on Tuesday.
Denmark, Poland and Romania, all affected by Thursday's disruptions, have previously accused Moscow directly of being behind hybrid attacks, while Germany blamed Russia for an August attack on Leipzig airport. Britain , which has in the past blamed Russia, linked Iran to a suspected plot against a US air base.
Both Russia and Iran deny any involvement.
Eric Schouten, head of aviation security group Dyami, said most of the countries affected supported Ukraine in its war against Russia's invasion.
While analysts at aviation risk advisory firm Osprey Flight Solutions said a link to Russia's hybrid campaign in Europe was a "realistic probability", they also cautioned that other explanations, including individuals acting on personal grievances and copycat incidents, were also possible.
An airport source in Italy told Reuters that an email with the subject line " Threat report" had been sent to several addresses for airlines, airport operators and airport service providers at Rome's Fiumicino and Milan's Malpensa airports.
The email, which claimed it was from "fighters of the Male State", said devices had been placed on inbound flights from Helsinki and Dublin and they would explode in 60 minutes.
Reuters could not independently confirm who had sent the email and there was no immediate indication of who was behind the other threat s across Europe.

FROM MILAN TO PRAGUE AND BEYOND Aer Lingus flight EI402 from Dublin to Rome landed safely at Evreux airport, 100km west of Paris, after being diverted as a security precaution, the Irish airline said in a statement.
Quoting the office of French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu, Reuters reported that the Airbus A320 plane was diverted to France's Evreux airbase.
The situation is being monitored by the Prime Minister's office, it added.
According to flight-tracking website Flightradar24, an Aer Lingus aircraft turned near Paris and was circling over the Evreux area after declaring an in-flight emergency.
France's air force said it had dispatched planes "as soon as the threat was reported", AFP reported. 
"The aircraft has been diverted and is being escorted to the Evreux airfield" west of Paris, it added.

An Aer Lingus Airbus A320 plane is seen at Evreux military air base after the flight from Dublin to Rome was diverted to France following a bomb threat, France on Nov 5, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Gonzalo Fuentes)

A Finnair flight from Helsinki, operated by charter airline Jettime, on Thursday landed as normal in Vienna after receiving a bomb threat , a spokesperson for the Finnish carrier said.
Finnair earlier said that another Finnair flight to Rome had landed after receiving a bomb threat, Reuters reported.
According to AFP, t he Helsinki-Rome flight was escorted to Rome by a fighter jet and was checked by bomb disposal experts.
Reuters, citing a source, reported that a flight operated by Polish airline LOT flying from Warsaw landed safely at Brussels Airport following a suspicious report.
A spokesperson for the airport told Belgian media that no additional security measures were necessary.
The airport did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

A view of Fiumicino Airport, after a Finnair plane from Helsinki was safely escorted to its scheduled landing in Rome by Italian air force jets following bomb threats that forced airliners to make unplanned landings across Europe, in Fiumicino, near Rome, Italy on Nov 5, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Remo Casilli)

Bulgarian officials meanwhile reported three aircraft making emergency landings in the Balkan country because of bomb threats. Airplanes flying from Copenhagen and Madrid landed safely in Sofia, the interior minister said, according to broadcaster bTV.
A third aircraft, from London, was diverted and landed in Plovdiv, Bulgaria's second-largest city, local media said. The government did not respond to requests for comment.
Spanish authorities said that three flights were affected by hoax bomb threats at Madrid's airport on Thursday morning, though they stressed that security forces had ruled out any risk.
It is unclear if this includes the plane from Madrid that had landed in Sofia. 
Meanwhile, Czech police on Thursday said four planes headed to Prague received bomb threats and the authorities were preparing for their landing, adding they assessed the credibility of the threat s as low.
"Nevertheless, we are not underestimating the threat , which is why all necessary security measures have been activated with minimal impact on passengers and airport operations," the police said on X. 
"After landing, all aircraft will undergo pyrotechnic inspections."   
CTK News agency later reported that no explosives were found in the four planes that landed in Prague, citing a police spokesperson. 
Separately, t he Romanian intelligence agency said on Thursday that a bomb threat was made on a Wizz Air flight from Milan to Bucharest, adding the plane landed safely in the Romanian capital, Reuters reported. 
Italy's ANSA news agency meanwhile reported on bomb alerts on two flights bound for Milan's Malpensa Airport, both of which have since landed safely. 

A screengrab from a video shows a police officer and a sniffer dog inspecting a Ryanair airplane and its baggage, according to Guardia Civil, in Murcia, Spain, Nov 3, 2026. (Image: Reuters/Forta)

The string of incidents comes after about 10 European flights were targeted by bomb threats on Tuesday , forcing the brief closure of a Warsaw airport and the scrambling of air force planes in Rome, according to authorities.
No explosives were found in the earlier incidents, despite extensive searches on the ground after the planes all took off and landed safely in different European cities just several hours apart, AFP reported. 
Irish budget carrier Ryanair appeared to be the worst hit, with four of its flights to different destinations being targeted.
Two bomb warnings targeted planes heading to the Polish capital Warsaw, including an SAS Scandinavian Airlines flight from Copenhagen and one from Heathrow operated by Polish airline LOT, Polish airport authorities said.
This week, unidentified hackers shut down fridges in supermarkets in several European countries. Some experts said hoax bomb threats could be part of a similar pattern of cheap, deniable disruption efforts.
Eliran Almog, CEO of aviation cybersecurity firm Cyviation, told Reuters the repeated threats could serve both to disrupt operations and to observe how airlines, airports and national authorities respond.
"These aviation threats are also occurring in the same period as cyberattacks on supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe," Almog said.
"Different essential services are experiencing disruption that carries economic costs and can undermine public confidence."

Source: Agencies/lk/fs

items.title: Pamela Anderson to be honoured with Lifetime Achievement Award at Torino Film Festival
items.summary: Actor-model Pamela Anderson will be honoured with a lifetime achievement award at Italy's Torino Film Festival, where she will be present to introduce a special screening of Gia Coppola's 'The Last ...
items.body:
Pamela Anderson to be honoured with Lifetime Achievement Award at Torino Film Festival At the Torino fest, Pamela Anderson will hold an onstage conversation ahead of 'The Last Showgirl'. 
ANI | Updated: 05-11-2026 22:29 IST | Created: 05-11-2026 22:29 IST

Pamela Anderson (File photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Actor-model Pamela Anderson will be honoured with a lifetime achievement award at Italy's Torino Film Festival, where she will be present to introduce a special screening of Gia Coppola's 'The Last Showgirl'. At the Torino fest, which is a pre-eminent event for young directors and indie cinema run by Italy's National Film Museum, Pamela Anderson will hold an onstage conversation ahead of 'The Last Showgirl'.
The film significantly earned her a 2025 Golden Globe nomination for her performance, also marking a comeback for the former 'Baywatch' star. "Movies can sometimes work wonders, like making us really meet for the first time someone we’ve known all our lives. With ‘The Last Showgirl,’ Pamela Anderson gave us this experience. We thought we knew everything about her, but in this film every gesture of hers revealed a sensitivity as a performer that is both moving and surprising," said Torino Film Festival artistic director Giulio Base, as quoted by Variety.
She will be honoured with Torino's Stella della Mole Award, previous recipients of which include Spike Lee, Antonio Banderas, Angelina Jolie and Sharon Stone. After 'The Last Showgirl', Anderson went on to feature alongside Liam Neeson in Paramount's reboot of 'The Naked Gun' and Karim Ainouz's family satire 'Rosebush Pruning'. She was subsequently at the Venice Film Festival in September with Kornel Mundruczo's road film 'Place To Be'.
She co-starred with Ellen Burstyn, Taika Waititi, and Murray Bartlett. On the current work front, Pamela Anderson recently wrapped shooting a slate of upcoming films, including Brian Klugman's 'Somedays' with Billy Bob Thornton, Michael Cera's 'Love Is Not the Answer', and Sally Potter's 'Alma'.
Meanwhile, Torino's 44th edition is set to take place between November 24 and December 2 in the Northern Italian city of Turin. (ANI)

items.title: 公的債務とノンバンク拡大、金融政策制約も＝シュナーベルＥＣＢ理事
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [フランクフルト ５日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のシュナーベル専務理事は５日、公的債務の増加とノンバンク金...
items.body:
公的債務とノンバンク拡大、金融政策制約も＝シュナーベルＥＣＢ理事
11/5 17:38 配信

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のシュナーベル専務理事。2019年11月22日、独フランクフルトで撮影。 REUTERS/Ralph Orlowski（ロイター） [フランクフルト ５日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のシュナーベル専務理事は５日、公的債務の増加とノンバンク金融の急拡大が、ＥＣＢのによる適切な金融政策運営を制約する恐れがあるとの見方を示した。

ＥＣＢは現在、高インフレ抑制へ利上げを進めている。ただ、債務返済コストの上昇で一部諸国、特に財政が脆弱なフランスでは財政の持続可能性が損なわれるとの懸念が広がっている。金融不安を引き起こすことへの警戒から、ＥＣＢの適切な政策運営が制約される可能性がある。

シュナーベル氏はフランクフルトでの講演で、今世紀に入って公的債務が膨張し、新たに発行された国債の多くを、高いレバレッジをかけている可能性があるヘッジファンドなどのノンバンクが保有していることが問題だと述べた。

こうした構造変化により、ＥＣＢの金利変更は従来より速く波及するようになり、市場の変動を増幅する恐れがある。その結果、担保価値が下落し、必要な証拠金が増えることで、レバレッジをかけた投資家が債券の投げ売りを迫られる可能性がある。

シュナーベル氏は「金融政策の波及機能を回復させるため、中央銀行は流動性危機が本格的な信用危機に発展するのを防ぐため、市場の安定化を余儀なくされる可能性がある」と指摘。「こうした介入は中央銀行の責務遂行を妨げ、金融政策の優位性を脅かしかねない」と述べた。

欧州は銀行規制を緩和する誘惑に抗し、むしろヘッジファンドや投資ファンド、保険会社などのノンバンクに対する規制を強化すべきだと述べた。

「ノンバンクへの規制強化は、中央銀行の資金供給制度へのアクセスを認めることを検討する根拠も強め、金融システムの安定をさらに支える可能性がある」と語った。シュナーベル氏は２０２７年１月にＥＣＢを退任し国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）幹部に転身する。

一方、各国政府が債務に対して支払う実効金利は経済成長率を上回っており、財政健全化の方がより難しい課題かもしれないと指摘。こうした状況は、欧州が長らく議論してきた制度改革に取り組む必要性を一段と高めているとし、改革により潜在成長率の低下をいずれ反転させることが可能だと述べた。

items.body:
独鉱工業受注、9月は前月比4.4％増　予想下回る
11/5 17:24 配信

[５日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦統計庁が５日発表した９月の鉱工業受注は、季節・暦日調整後で前月比４．４％増加した。自動車の受注が伸びたものの、増加率は市場予想を下回った。

ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想は４．８％増だった。

製造業の新規受注を主に押し上げたのは自動車で、受注は前月比１０．５％増と大幅に伸びた。生産の切り替えや工場の休業に伴い、それまでの２カ月間、新規受注と生産が低水準にとどまっていたことが一因だ。

機械・設備製造業の受注も８．３％増加し、全体を押し上げた。大型受注が寄与した。

変動の小さい３カ月ごとの比較では、第３・四半期の新規受注全体は第２・四半期を０．２％上回った。

８月の新規受注は速報値の前月比１０．６％減から１０．１％減に改定された。

items.summary:
Kentaro Okasaka

[韮崎(山梨県) ５日 ロイター] - 半導体製造装置大手、東京エレクトロンの製造子会...
items.body:
ＡＩ「必ず伸びる」、米中間選の影響はコメントせず＝東エレク子会社
11/5 17:17 配信

Kentaro Okasaka

[韮崎(山梨県) ５日 ロイター] - 半導体製造装置大手、東京エレクトロンの製造子会社、東京エレクトロンテクノロジーソリューションズの両角友一朗社長が５日、山梨県韮崎市の本社で報道陣のインタビューに応じた。米中間選挙で民主党が上下両院の過半数を奪還し、ＡＩ（人工知能）規制が強まるとの見方については「コメントする立場にはない」としつつ、「ＡＩは必ず伸びるとは考えている」と述べ、需要は今後も伸長するとの見方を示した。

５日の東京株式市場では米中間選の結果を受けたＡＩ規制強化への警戒感が引き続き重しとなり、東京エレクトロンを含むＡＩ・半導体関連株の下げが目立った。両角社長は「米国での選挙や、それらがどういう風に影響するかを考えるよりも、半導体をつくっている顧客がどういうディマンドをわれわれに持ってくるかという方を重視している」との立場を示した。

また「明日、明後日も大事だが５年後、１０年後にどうなっていくのかが大事」と指摘。ＡＩは「まだ生まれてようやくよちよち歩き、二足歩行に入るくらいの状態。まだまだこれからいろんな発展を見せるだろう」と述べ、フィジカルＡＩなどへの半導体の適用などで「市場自体は必ず伸びていくんだろうなと考えている」と語った。

一方、北方華創科技集団（ＮＡＵＲＡ）など中国の製造装置メーカーとの競争について、「中国だからというわけではなく、いつの時代も新たな装置メーカーの競合は生まれる。われわれが必ず考えるのは、その競合他社に対して１歩でも２歩でも先の技術をつくっていこうということだ」と強調。それが新規参入を阻む「大きな手段だ」とし、「競合が出てきたからなんとかそれを守ろうということではなく、競合のさらに上を行かないといつか追い付かれるという気持ちで対応していこうと思っている」と話した。

同社は、半導体製造工程のうち成膜やエッチング装置、テストシステムの開発や製造を手掛ける。

items.body:
コメルツ銀、ウニクレディトとの統合に前向き　「価値創出を確信」
11/5 17:04 配信

ドイツのコメルツ銀行のロゴ。3月16日、ドイツのケルンで撮影。REUTERS/Thilo Schmuelgen（ロイター） Tom Sims　Philipp Krach

[フランクフルト ５日 ロイター] - ドイツのコメルツ銀行は５日、イタリアのウニクレディトとの統合で価値を生み出せると表明した。統合の可能性について、これまでよりはるかに前向きな姿勢を示した。

ベッティーナ・オルロップ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「ウニクレディトとともに両行の強みを生かすことで、価値を生み出せると確信している」と述べた。

コメルツ銀は、ウニクレディトによる買収手続きが「今後数カ月で」完了するとの見通しを示した。投資家向け説明資料で、コスト削減と収益拡大に向けた具体的な手段があるとした。

「株主は当行の実績に加え、ウニクレディト・グループ内でのさらなる成長余地からも恩恵を受ける」と表明した。

コメルツ銀が同日発表した第３・四半期決算は、純利益が前年同期比４５％増の８億５９００万ユーロ（９億６７３２万ドル）となった。同行が公表したアナリスト予想の平均は８億６４００万ユーロだった。

１─９月の業績は過去最高だったとしている。

items.body:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（5日）
11/5 16:46 配信

中国・香港株式市場は上昇して引けた。米中間選挙を受けセンチメントが回復し、香港株は２１カ月ぶりの大幅高となった。中国株は小幅に上昇した。

香港のハンセン指数は３．７％高で終了。２０２５年２月以来の大幅な上昇率を記録した。

ハンセンテック指数は５．６％急伸。指数への影響が大きいアリババとテンセントは、それぞれ８％超、７％超上昇した。

米中間選挙後の不透明感の後退が好感され、前日の米株高に追随した。

モーニングスターのアナリストは５日公表の投資見通しで「中国と香港は引き続き相対的に魅力がある」と指摘した。１０月の調整局面では、ハンセン指数が５％、ＣＳＩ３００指数が９％下落していた。

同社のアジア株式調査ディレクター、ロレイン・タン氏は、ファンダメンタルズの悪化ではなく、人工知能（ＡＩ）への懸念から大きく売られた優良銘柄には、今回の調整が反発の機会をもたらす可能性もあると述べた。同社はアリババとテンセントに強気の見方を示している。

珠海華発集団が地元政府から資金支援を受けたことを受け、不動産株が反発したことも相場を支えた。

中国本土Ａ株市場では、ＣＳＩ３００指数が０．３％高、上海総合指数が０．１％高で終了した。

業種別では、太陽光発電株、半導体株、新エネルギー株が買われた。一方、石油株と光通信株は売られた。

ＣＣＢインターナショナルのチーフエコノミスト、クリフ・チャオ氏は、民主党が米中間選挙で圧勝した後も、先端技術を巡る米中の競争は続くと予想。民主党が商務省の輸出許可に対する議会の監視を強化し、関連する規制法案を推進する可能性があるとした。

同氏は「中国国内の技術サプライチェーンでは、明暗がさらに分かれる可能性がある」と指摘。米国のＡＩ設備投資に大きく依存するハードウエア輸出企業は影響を受ける可能性がある一方、画像処理半導体（ＧＰＵ）、半導体製造装置、先端パッケージング、計算インフラは、技術自立の必要性から引き続き恩恵を受ける可能性があると述べた。

国有石油大手ペトロチャイナは８％下落した。民主党の勝利で米国とイランの戦争終結への期待が高まり、原油価格が下落したことが圧迫した。

深セン総合指数は１．６％高。深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は０．９％高、上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は１．７％高となった。

ソウル株式市場は５％超下落し、終値で７カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。米中間選挙での民主党勝利を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資の減速懸念から米ハイテク株が下落。韓国の半導体株も売られた。

総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）は前日終値比３００ポイント（５．２８％）安の５３８３．８０で終了。終値として４月３日以来の安値となった。

取引時間中には、プログラム取引を一時制限する「サイドカー」が発動され、下落率は一時６．１％に達した。

前日の米株式市場は、中間選挙の結果を受けて政治的不透明感が和らぎ、リスク選好が高まったことで大幅高となった。ただ、ＡＩ規制強化への懸念からデータセンター関連株は下落。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は３．１％下落した。

韓国企画財政省は、米国のＡＩ関連政策・規制の変化を注視すると表明した。

半導体大手のサムスン電子は７．５７％、同業のＳＫハイニックスは９．４６％、それぞれ下落した。

電池大手のＬＧエナジー・ソリューションは２．５４％安。同業のサムスンＳＤＩとＳＫイノベーションはそれぞれ６．６１％、７．６８％下落した。これらの銘柄は前日、民主党の気候変動対策重視の政策によって電気自動車（ＥＶ）の需要が拡大するとの期待から上昇していた。

電池材料メーカーのＬＧ化学とポスコ・ホールディングスも下落した。

取引された９１２銘柄のうち、３４４銘柄が上昇、５３７銘柄が下落した。

海外投資家は３兆４０００億ウォン（２５億３０００万ドル）相当の株式を売り越した。

シドニー株式市場は急伸し、１年超ぶりの大幅高で引けた。米中間選挙を受けイラン戦争終結への期待が高まった。主要指数は９０００の大台を突破した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ／ＡＳＸ２００指数は２．６％高の９０６５．１０で終了。９月以来の高値を付け、２０２５年４月以来の大幅な上昇率を記録した。

原油価格は１バレル＝１００ドルを割り込んだ。

バンテージ・マーケッツのシニアマーケットアナリスト、ヘベ・チェン氏は「豪株はきょう、安心感から力強く上昇している。全１１業種のうち８業種が上昇しており、投資家のリスク選好が回復しつつあることを示している」と述べた。

資源株指数は８％近く上げ構成指数で上昇率トップとなった。２０２０年３月以来の大幅高だった。ＢＨＰは６．２％、リオティントは７％、それぞれ上昇した。

ヘルスケア株指数は３．６％高、情報技術株指数は１０．１％高となった。

原油価格の急落が追い風となり、カンタス航空は６．２％急伸。競合のヴァージン・オーストラリアは１１．２％上昇した。

一方、エネルギー株指数は４．８％下落し、終値で７月下旬以来の安値を付けた。ウッドサイド・エナジーは６％、サントスは５．４％、それぞれ下落した。

金融株指数も下落。ナショナル・オーストラリア銀行（ＮＡＢ）は５．４％安。通期利益の減少幅が予想以上となり、信用減損費用が約８６％増加したことが嫌気された。

チェン氏は、ＮＡＢの急落は決算が予想を下回ったことが要因とみられると指摘。ただ、金利の変動、不動産市場の軟化、借り手の資金繰り悪化が大手行を圧迫しており、銀行業界全体の見通しも不透明感が増していると述べた。

items.title: Jeremy Renner to star in '12 Bullets' movie from 'John Wick' producer
items.summary: Oscar-nominated actor and action star Jeremy Renner is gearing up to take on London’s criminal underworld in 12 Bullets, a new action thriller from John Wick producer Thunder Road and Comcast-owned UK ...
items.body:
Jeremy Renner to star in '12 Bullets' movie from 'John Wick' producer  Oscar-nominated actor and action star Jeremy Renner is gearing up to take on London’s criminal underworld in 12 Bullets, a new action thriller from John Wick producer Thunder Road and Comcast-owned UK broadcaster Sky.
ANI | Updated: 05-11-2026 21:15 IST | Created: 05-11-2026 21:15 IST

Jeremy Renner (Image source: Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Oscar-nominated actor and action star Jeremy Renner is gearing up to take on London’s criminal underworld in 12 Bullets, a new action thriller from John Wick producer Thunder Road and Comcast-owned UK broadcaster Sky. In 12 Bullets, “a mysterious American must wage a one-man war against rival criminal gangs tearing through London’s supposedly gun-free streets while armed with a single gun. But with only twelve bullets, every shot must count," as per Deadline.
The film will be helmed by Sean Ellis (Anthropoid), who will direct from a screenplay penned by Tim Walker. Thunder Road’s Basil Iwanyk and Erica Lee are attached to produce the project. Developed jointly by Sky and Thunder Road, 12 Bullets is set for a UK and Ireland release as a Sky Original, while CAA Media Finance is handling sales of the film’s North American distribution rights. The project serves as a reunion for Thunder Road and Renner, who starred in The Town and Wind River, as well as Thunder Road and 193’s Patrick Wachsberger, who represented sales for past Thunder Road films including Sicario, John Wick and The Surgeon.
Speaking about the film, 193 CEO Patrick Wachsberger said, “12 Bullets is exactly the kind of bold, high-concept action thriller that gets our attention. With London as its backdrop and a hero forced to make every bullet count, the film delivers a compelling premise with international appeal. Thunder Road has been an important longtime partner, and we’re excited to join forces with them again on a project that brings together everything audiences love about the genre with a fresh, distinctive edge. We look forward to introducing the film to buyers at AFM.” (ANI)

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [シドニー ５日 ロイター] - オーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）のハウザー副総裁は５日、インフレを抑える中銀の能力...
items.body:
豪中銀のインフレ抑制能力、国民の信頼に揺らぎ＝副総裁
11/5 16:42 配信

オーストラリア準備銀行の建物前。2017年2月、シドニーで撮影。REUTERS/Steven Saphore（ロイター） [シドニー ５日 ロイター] - オーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）のハウザー副総裁は５日、インフレを抑える中銀の能力に対する国民の信頼が揺らいでいるとの認識を示した。信頼が失われれば物価上昇圧力を抑え込むためのコストがさらに膨らむおそれがあると警告した。

今年５回目となる利上げ後にキャンベラで講演し、インフレ抑制の責務を果たす豪中銀の能力について、一部の国民の信頼が弱まっていると述べた。

「国民が中銀の戦略を理解し信頼していれば、一定のディスインフレを実現するのに必要な政策対応は小さくて済み、生産の損失というコストも抑えられる」と説明した。国民の信頼がなければ、インフレ率を速やかに引き下げるために大幅な利上げが必要になると語った。

インフレ率は２─３％の目標範囲を５年以上にわたって上回っている。ハウザー氏は、これまでに積み重なった物価上昇が国民の怒りをあおっているようだと述べた。金融政策の効果が表れるまでには時間がかかるため、インフレ鈍化の恩恵を受ける前に借り入れコスト上昇の痛みを感じることが多いと指摘した。

「政策効果が表れるのを待つ間、人々は困難で負担の大きい調整を強いられる」とし、「その間、人々がわれわれの対応は適切だと確信できることが必要だ」と語った。

「信頼は初めから与えられるものではない。人々の声に耳を傾け、学び、率直に語り続けることで、絶えず勝ち取っていかなければならない。結果が期待に届かない時も含めて検証を歓迎する」と述べた。

items.body:
日経平均は4日続落、ＡＩ関連株売り継続　ＴＯＰＩＸしっかり
11/5 16:02 配信

写真は2020年10月、東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は４日続落し、前営業日比１．７９％（１１１０円７３銭安）の６万１０７７円９０銭で取引を終えた。朝方はプラスでスタートしたものの、指数寄与度の大きいＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連への売りが継続し、次第にマイナス圏に沈んだ。後場は一段と下げ幅を拡大し、一時６万１０００円を割り込んだ。一方、ＴＯＰＩＸはしっかりだった。

日経平均は前営業日比０．３２％高でスタートした後は徐々に軟化。米中間選挙の結果を受けたＡＩ規制強化やデータセンター建設遅延の思惑が引き続き重しとなり、関連銘柄が大幅に売られた。後場終盤にかけて日経平均はさらに下げ幅を拡大し、一時２．２６％（１４０２円４４銭）安の６万０７８６円１９銭で安値を付けた。半面、自動車などのバリュー（割安）株やＡＩ以外の主力株への物色が活発で、プライム市場全体では７割超の銘柄が上昇した。

決算を発表した銘柄の売り買いも目立ち、後場に業績見通しの引き上げや株主還元強化を発表したトヨタ自動車は１６％超高となった。

マネックス証券のチーフ・マーケット・アナリスト、吉野貴晶氏は「中間選挙を経てデータセンター建設への懸念が高まっていることから、ＡＩ・半導体関連はどうしても売られやすくなってしまっている」と指摘する。目先は「原油価格の下落でインフレ懸念が緩和されるとの思惑で、内需株が見直されそうだ。当面は内需株やバリュー株に資金が向かいやすい」とみている。

ＴＯＰＩＸは１．１６％高の３９４０．３９ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比１．１６％高の２０３０．９２ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は１１兆７８５０億１６００万円だった。東証３３業種では、輸送用機器、不動産、ゴム製品など２５業種が値上がり。非鉄金属、鉱業、海運など８業種は値下がりした。

新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が５日続落し、２．３２％安の７５１．４６ポイントだった。

個別では、アドバンテストが１４％超安、キオクシアホールディングスが１３％超安と大幅下落。東京エレクトロン、イビデン、ＴＤＫも軟調。ファーストリテイリングは４％超高で堅調。自動車株は全面高で、ホンダやスズキが大幅高となった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが１１３０銘柄（７２％）、値下がりは４１０銘柄（２６％）、変わらずは１２銘柄（０％）だった。

items.summary:
Scott Murdoch　Sameer Manekar

[５日 ロイター] - 豪ナショナル・オーストラリア銀行（Ｎ...
items.body:
豪成長率は1％程度に、景気後退リスクも　大手銀トップが指摘
11/5 15:59 配信

写真はナショナル・オーストラリア銀行（ＮＡＢ）のロゴ。2025年5月、シドニーで撮影。REUTERS/Hollie Adams（ロイター） Scott Murdoch　Sameer Manekar

[５日 ロイター] - 豪ナショナル・オーストラリア銀行（ＮＡＢ）のアンドリュー・アービン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は５日、オーストラリアでリセッション（景気後退）リスクが高まっているとの認識を示した。今年５回の利上げの負担が消費者にのしかかり、経済成長は横ばいとなっていると指摘した。

「（経済）成長率は１％程度になるというのが中心シナリオだ」と述べた。「景気後退が最も可能性の高いシナリオだとは考えていないが、その確率はおそらく高まっている」とした。

オーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）が今年実施した一連の利上げの負担を、ＮＡＢの顧客はこれまでのところ吸収できていると述べた。

失業率が「やや上昇する」との見方を示し、「今回で利上げが終わり、来年冬ごろには利下げが始まることを期待している」と語った。

豪中銀は３日、政策金利を２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げ、１８年ぶりの高水準となる４．８５％とした。

ＮＡＢが５日発表した９月末までの通期決算は、調整後利益（キャッシュ利益）が６１億４０００万豪ドル（４３億米ドル）となった。ビジブル・アルファがまとめた市場予想の６３億３０００万豪ドルを下回り、前年の７０億９０００万豪ドルから減少した。与信費用が８６％増加したことが響いたほか、コストも予想を上回った。

items.title: 午後3時のドルは157円後半に下落、株や金利にらみ　原油動向にも注目
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 ５日 ロイター] -

  ドル...
items.body:
午後3時のドルは157円後半に下落、株や金利にらみ　原油動向にも注目
11/5 15:55 配信

写真は米ドル紙幣。2022年2月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 ５日 ロイター] -

  ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 157.88／157.91 1.1260／1.1261 177.78／177.79

午前９時現在 158.35／158.36 1.1232／1.1238 177.90／177.95

ＮＹ午後５時 158.38／158.41 1.1227／1.1230 177.86／177.89

午後３時のドル／円は、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤と比べてドル安／円高の１５７円後半で推移している。株式の動向に左右される相場が続き、軟調な日経平均や米金利の低下を受けてドル／円も軟化した。米中間選挙結果を受け、イランでの戦闘終結期待から原油価格が下落基調にあるとして、今後の原油価格動向がドル／円相場の鍵になるとの見方もある。

朝方は１５８円前半で推移していたドルは、日経平均の下げや米金利の低下を背景に１５７円後半までじりじりと値を下げた。いったん１５８円台を回復する場面もあったものの、午後にかけては１５８円をやや下回る水準でのもみ合いが続いた。

米中間選挙の結果を巡っては、民主党が上下院とも多数派を握ったとしても自由な裁量が得られるわけではないとの見方が聞かれる。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の規制強化への懸念などから株が一段安となればドル／円の下げにつながるとの見方は依然として根強い一方、事前の織り込みも入っていたことなどもあり、株式市場やドル／円相場の下げは深まらなかった。

前日はむしろドル／円相場の底堅さが意識されたとの声もあり、円ロング気味だったドル／円のポジション解消がイベント通過後に一部で進んだことが指摘されている。ボラティリティーが低下する中では、「アップサイド（上方向）にはそれほど動かないと思いながらも、キャリー（金利差から生じる収益）を取ったほうが有益」（スタンダードチャータード銀行東京支店の江沢福紘マーケッツ本部長）として、ドル買い／円売りにつながる可能性もあるため、円買い方向には行きづらくなるとの見方もある。

一方、高止まりからの巻き戻しが続く原油相場に関しては、一段安か持ち直しかが次の展開として鍵となりそうだという。このまま下がり続けるようならインフレ懸念を背景とする利上げ見通しの変化も想定され、「ドル／円相場では円高方向のファクター」（江沢氏）という。

items.title: 23 years, 234 caps, 146 goals: Cristiano Ronaldo brings curtain down on international career for Portugal
items.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo's international career has come to an end after 23 years, with the Portugal captain announcing his retirement from national team football on Thursday, bringing the curtain down on a ...
items.body:
23 years, 234 caps, 146 goals: Cristiano Ronaldo brings curtain down on international career for Portugal Cristiano Ronaldo's international career has come to an end after 23 years, with the Portugal captain announcing his retirement from national team football on Thursday, bringing the curtain down on a remarkable journey in which he established himself as the men's game’s most prolific international goalscorer and most-capped player.
ANI | Updated: 05-11-2026 18:18 IST | Created: 05-11-2026 18:18 IST

Cristiano Ronaldo (Photo: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Cristiano Ronaldo's international career has come to an end after 23 years, with the Portugal captain announcing his retirement from national team football on Thursday, bringing the curtain down on a remarkable journey in which he established himself as the men's game’s most prolific international goalscorer and most-capped player. The 41-year-old Al-Nassr forward leaves international football with 146 goals in 234 appearances for Portugal, both all-time records in men's international football. His career with the national team began on August 20, 2003, when he made his debut as a substitute against Kazakhstan, and concluded on September 24, 2026.
Ronaldo announced his decision through a video message on Instagram, describing his 23-year journey with Portugal as one that had changed his life forever. He also spoke about handing over the iconic number seven shirt to the next generation, while making it clear that his association with the national team would continue as a supporter. "To the Portuguese people, the day has come for me to hand back the number 7 shirt of our National Team. I never felt it belonged to me alone. But for 23 years, I had the privilege and the responsibility of wearing it, defending it, and carrying it with me into stadiums all around the world. Today, the time has come to pass it on to the future," Ronaldo said in an Instagram post.
His retirement marks the end of one of the most statistically extraordinary international careers in football history. From his first appearance as a teenager to becoming Portugal's captain and leading the country to major international honours, Ronaldo's contribution extended across six European Championships and six FIFA World Cup editions. Ronaldo's 234 international appearances place him at the top of the men's all-time list, while his 146 goals give him a substantial lead over the other leading international goalscorers.
His scoring record translates to an average of approximately 0.62 goals per international appearance, an extraordinary return for a career spanning more than two decades. He is also the first player to score in six different editions of the FIFA World Cup, having found the net at the 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018, 2022 and 2026 tournaments.
The Portuguese forward has scored 11 goals in 27 World Cup appearances, making him his country's leading goalscorer in the competition. His 14 goals in the European Championship final tournaments are also a men's record. Ronaldo has scored in 49 different national-team opponents, underlining his consistency across a wide range of international competitions and qualifying campaigns. Luxembourg have been his most frequent victim, conceding 11 goals to him, followed by Hungary with nine.
His international record also includes 10 hat-tricks, including two four-goal performances. He has scored 22 penalties for Portugal and registered 124 goals in competitive international fixtures, excluding friendlies. The numbers reflect not only his longevity but also his ability to maintain a high level of performance across different generations of Portuguese football.
One of the defining aspects of Ronaldo's international career was his consistency at major tournaments. He scored 14 goals in 30 appearances at the European Championship, having represented Portugal in six editions — 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020 and 2024. His first appearance at the Euros came in 2004, when Portugal hosted the tournament. Ronaldo scored his first senior international goal against Greece in the group stage, although the hosts eventually suffered a defeat against the same opponents in the final.
Over the following two decades, he became the face of Portuguese football at the continental championship, setting records for appearances and goals. His 14 goals at the European Championship remain unmatched in the men's competition. He also holds the record for the most appearances in the tournament's final stages, with 30 matches across six editions.
Ronaldo's contribution at the World Cup was equally significant in terms of longevity. He featured in six consecutive editions from 2006 to 2026, scoring 11 goals in 27 matches. He is the only player to have scored at six different men's World Cups, having registered goals in Germany (2006), South Africa (2010), Brazil (2014), Russia (2018), Qatar (2022) and the 2026 edition.
His combined tally of 25 goals at the European Championship and FIFA World Cup is another record, highlighting his ability to deliver on the biggest international stages. Beyond the final tournaments, Ronaldo also established himself as one of Europe's most prolific players in qualifying competitions. He scored 41 goals in European Championship qualifiers and another 41 in World Cup qualifying matches.
His record of 15 goals in the UEFA Nations League further demonstrates his impact across the different formats of international football. Ronaldo's international journey began when he was just 18 years old. Having emerged through Sporting CP's youth system and made his senior club debut in Portugal, he received his first opportunity with the national team against Kazakhstan in August 2003.
His first international goal came less than a year later, against Greece at Euro 2004. Although Portugal lost the final of that tournament, Ronaldo's performances marked the beginning of a long association with the national side. He became an increasingly influential figure in the team, eventually taking over the captaincy and becoming the central figure in Portugal's attack.
His international career included several difficult moments, particularly Portugal's unsuccessful campaigns at major tournaments. However, the defining achievement arrived at Euro 2016 in France. Portugal defeated hosts France 1-0 after extra time in the final to win their first-ever European Championship. Ronaldo, who had to leave the final early due to injury, continued to encourage his teammates from the touchline as Portugal secured the historic victory.
The triumph represented a major milestone for Portuguese football and the first senior international trophy of Ronaldo's career. Three years later, Portugal added another major honour by winning the inaugural UEFA Nations League in 2019. Ronaldo played a key role in the campaign, scoring a hat-trick in the semi-final against Switzerland before Portugal defeated the Netherlands in the final.
Portugal subsequently won the Nations League again in 2025, giving Ronaldo another major international title towards the latter stages of his career. His international trophy collection therefore included Euro 2016 and two Nations League titles, in 2019 and 2025.
Ronaldo's international numbers are particularly remarkable because they were accumulated across different generations of Portuguese football. He began his career as a young winger known for his pace, dribbling and ability to take on defenders. Over the years, he developed into a more direct goalscorer, becoming one of the most prolific forwards in world football.
His scoring record against 49 different national teams reflects his consistency against opponents of varying strengths. Luxembourg, against whom he scored 11 times, and Hungary, with nine goals conceded, feature prominently among his most frequent international victims. His 10 international hat-tricks also underline his ability to produce high-scoring performances. The tally includes two occasions when he scored four goals in a single match.
Another notable aspect of his record is the number of competitive goals he scored. With 124 goals in competitive international fixtures, excluding friendlies, Ronaldo demonstrated that his contribution was not restricted to exhibition matches. He also became Portugal's youngest player to reach 100 international appearances and went on to establish himself as the country's oldest goalscorer.
The gap between Ronaldo and Portugal's previous leading players is considerable. Pauleta, who held the national scoring record before him, finished his international career with 47 goals, while former captain and midfielder Luis Figo made 127 appearances. Ronaldo surpassed both records and continued extending his numbers for several years.
In his retirement announcement, Ronaldo reflected on the sacrifices, responsibilities and emotions associated with representing his country for more than two decades. He said his ambition throughout his international career was always to improve, win trophies and take Portugal to greater heights.
"Throughout my entire career with the National Team, I always pushed myself beyond my limits. I wanted to win. I wanted to be better. I wanted to make history. I always demanded the most of myself. I always wanted more. I always believed we could go further. And I gave everything I had for this shirt," he said. Ronaldo also acknowledged the contribution of his teammates, coaches, medical staff and other members of the Portuguese football setup, saying their collective efforts had been central to his journey.
He reserved special gratitude for his family and the supporters who stood by him throughout his career. He also recalled the emotional experience of hearing Portugal's national anthem before matches, describing it as one of the memories he would cherish. For Ronaldo, the opportunity to represent Portugal eventually became more important than individual records and personal achievements.
"I spent my life working to become the best player in the world. Today, I realise that my greatest victory was earning the honour of representing the best country in the world," he said. He also assured Portuguese supporters that his retirement would not end his association with the national team.
"Today, my journey on the pitch with the National Team comes to an end. I leave with my head held high, proud of the path I have taken, and knowing that I gave everything I had for Portugal. But I will never stop being one of you. I will keep suffering, cheering, and celebrating every Portuguese victory," he added. While his international career has ended, Ronaldo is expected to continue playing at club level with Saudi Arabian side Al-Nassr.
The forward has continued to be productive in front of goal and is also approaching another significant individual milestone. According to the career figures available at the time of his retirement announcement, he has scored 985 official senior goals for club and country in 1,343 appearances, leaving him just 15 goals short of the unprecedented 1,000-goal mark. He recently scored a hat-trick in Al-Nassr's 5-3 victory against Al-Kholood on October 29, underlining that his ambitions on the club stage remain intact.
His retirement announcement also comes after a disciplinary episode involving the Portuguese Football Federation in October. Ronaldo was fined 255 euros and handed a 30-day suspension following his departure from the national team camp ahead of a match against Denmark. The suspension was backdated to October 1, meaning he had already served most of it and did not miss an official Portugal fixture. However, his farewell message made clear that the decision to step away from international football was about bringing an end to a journey that began in 2003.
Ronaldo leaves behind a record that combines extraordinary numbers with longevity, leadership and major tournament success. His 234 appearances and 146 goals place him at the top of men's international football, while his six World Cup appearances and six European Championship campaigns underline his remarkable staying power. He acknowledged in his farewell that records are meant to be broken, but the numbers he has accumulated over 23 years provide an extraordinary benchmark for future generations.
For Portuguese football, the departure of its greatest international goalscorer and most-capped player marks the end of a defining era. The number seven shirt will now pass to another generation, but Ronaldo's legacy with the national team will remain closely tied to Portugal's rise to the top of European football. As he signed off, his message to the country was simple: "Thank you for these 23 years. Thank you for believing in me. Thank you for allowing me to live a dream that began when I was just a little boy in Madeira, running after a football."
The number seven shirt will move on, but the records and memories created by Ronaldo over 23 years will remain a defining chapter in Portugal's football history. (ANI)

items.title: Bangladesh garment factories close as workers clash with police in protests
items.author: AP
items.summary: Police in Bangladesh fired tear gas and used stun grenades Wednesday to disperse garment workers protesting for higher wages, police and witnesses said.
items.body: Police in Bangladesh fired tear gas and used stun grenades Wednesday to disperse garment workers protesting for higher wages, police and witnesses said.Hundreds of factories remained shut after days of protests disrupted the country's garment industry, which earns about $40 billion a year from exports. Bangladesh has some 2,500 garment factories.Workers are demanding a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 takas ($245), up from 12,500 takas. They say rising living costs and inflation have eroded their purchasing power.The industry employs about 4 million workers, mostly women from rural Bangladesh.After days of demonstrations in the capital, Dhaka, violence was reported in several industrial areas on its outskirts.In Fatullah, in Narayanganj district outside Dhaka, dozens of people were injured in clashes between protesters and police, according to media reports. Police fired tear gas and used stun grenades.Prothom Alo, Bangladesh's largest Bengali-language daily, reported that police arrested several protesters in Fatullah.About 100 factories remain shut in Ashulia, in Savar near Dhaka, said Mominul Islam Bhuiyan, superintendent of Ashulia Industrial Police.Workers also blocked a major highway in Gazipur district, another major industrial hub.More than 10,000 police officers had been deployed in Dhaka's Mirpur area, an epicenter of recent protests, to maintain order, said Mahidul Islam, a joint police commissioner.The government has responded to the wage demands by forming a new wage board.The board's chairman, Syed Azad Subhani, said workers would receive their first salaries under the new pay scale in January.

items.summary: The Centre has committed financial incentives of ₹46,000 crore under two schemes to encourage coal gasification projects, said Coal Ministry Secretary Vikram Dev Dutt ...
items.body:
Home / Industry / News / Coal gasification can save ₹1.5 trillion in forex in 5-7 years: Coal secy

Coal gasification can save ₹1.5 trillion in forex in 5-7 years: Coal secy The Centre has committed financial incentives of ₹46,000 crore under two schemes to encourage coal gasification projects, said Coal Ministry Secretary Vikram Dev Dutt

Coal gasification projects require substantial upfront capital investment as well as support at the state level in terms of electricity, water supply and taxation | Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India Panaji 4 min read Last Updated : Nov 05 2026 | 2:26 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Coal gasification projects have the potential to save India around ₹1.5 trillion in foreign exchange over the next five to seven years through import substitution, Coal Ministry Secretary Vikram Dev Dutt said on Thursday.
The Centre has committed financial incentives of ₹46,000 crore under two schemes to encourage coal gasification projects, Dutt said, addressing the 4th Conference of Mining Ministers on Reforms in the Mines and Coal Sector in South Goa.
"Mining with a conscience" should be the guiding principle for responsible miners, the official added.
He said coal gasification, which converts coal into synthetic gas (syngas), can help manufacture several products that India currently imports in substantial quantities.
  "If the coal gasification projects get underway and gain scale, we would be succeeding in about five to seven years in saving about Rs one and a half trillion potentially of foreign exchange through this import substitution," Dutt said.

"Coal gasification has the potential of becoming an instrument of industrial diversification and regional development," the official said, urging coal-producing states to introduce supportive policies to attract investments in the sector.
Methanol, ethanol, and ammonium nitrate used in explosives and inputs for direct reduced iron (DRI)-based steel production could be manufactured through coal gasification, he noted.
Odisha and Maharashtra have already introduced incentive policies to promote coal gasification, with projects coming up in clusters in Odisha's Angul district and Maharashtra's Chandrapur belt, Dutt pointed out.
He also called upon coal-rich states such as Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Odisha to formulate policies offering incentives to investors, saying this would help attract projects and ensure that the benefits of central government schemes reach resource-rich regions.
Coal gasification projects require substantial upfront capital investment as well as support at the state level in terms of electricity, water supply and taxation. Maharashtra and Odisha have taken steps in this direction, he said.
Emphasising the employment potential of the sector, Dutt said gasification plants would generate jobs in downstream industries and benefit skilled and semi-skilled workers, besides strengthening local supply chains and creating additional economic activity.
On coal sector reforms, Dutt said the commercial mining policy introduced in 2020 removed restrictions on end-use and sale of coal, paving the way for greater private participation.
He said 137 mines had been allocated through 15 rounds of auctions, with captive and commercial mines accounting for around 20 per cent of India's total coal production.
The government has also expanded the number of agencies authorised to undertake mineral exploration from 13 government agencies to 57, including 44 accredited private agencies, he informed.
Dutt urged state governments to expedite land acquisition, public hearings, statutory clearances and other permissions required for operationalising coal blocks, saying delays in these processes often hinder mining projects.
Faster operationalisation of auctioned coal blocks would ensure that states receive royalty and other revenue streams earlier, enabling them to fund development programmes, he stressed.
Highlighting environmental initiatives, Dutt said the Coal Ministry had identified 147 mines for scientific closure over three years, of which 43 had already been scientifically closed.
Scientific mine closure was not merely about technically sealing mines but also restoring degraded environments and repurposing mining areas after assessing the needs of local communities, he noted.
The ministry has developed a digital tool called 'SuVikalp' to facilitate the assessment and repurposing of closed mines, he added.
Dutt also stressed that the future of the coal sector should go beyond production targets and focus on productivity, technological advancement, transparency and environmental responsibility.
"Mining with a conscience" should be the guiding principle for responsible miners, he said.
The official also called for greater coordination between the Centre, state governments, coal companies and other stakeholders to make the sector competitive, efficient and environmentally sustainable.
Union Minister for Coal and Mines G Kishan Reddy, MoS for Mines Satish Chandra Dubey and Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant were present on the occasion.

items.title: MMG, Anglo American extend $500 million nickel deal deadline
items.author: Marina Meireles
items.creator: Marina Meireles
items.summary: The extension comes as European regulators continue to investigate the deal and its impact on steel production.
items.body:
MMG, Anglo American extend $500 million nickel deal deadline

Marina Meireles | November 3, 2026 | 10:43 am
Regulatory Issues   Top Companies   Asia   Latin America   Nickel  

Niquelândia processes both nickel and manganese from Codemin and Barro Alto sites. ( Image courtesy of Anglo American. )

MMG (HKEX: 1208) and Anglo American (LON: AAL) extended the deadline for their $500-million Brazilian nickel deal by two months as European Union regulators scrutinize its potential impact on the region’s stainless steel industry. 

The companies agreed to move the long-stop date from Oct. 31 to Dec. 31, 2026, rather than terminate the transaction after failing to secure regulatory approval. The extension gives t

hem time to address concerns raised by the European Commission (EC), which has launched an in-depth Phase II investigation and is expected to issue its decision by Dec. 21. 

MMG said it will continue to work with the EU and Anglo American to assist the EU in its review. 

Anglo agreed last year to sell its Brazilian nickel operations to MMG, prompting regulatory scrutiny over the potential impact on ferronickel supplies. The deal includes two ferronickel and two greenfield projects in Brazil.  

Brazil probes Anglo’s $500M nickel sale to China’s MMG

Twists and Turns  

While the deal was announced in early 2025, the EU has been reviewing its possibility and the impacts it would have on ferronickel supply for the Union’s steel production since September 2025. 

The European Commission (EC) is primarily concerned about whether the acquisition could allow MMG to divert Brazilian ferronickel away from Europe. This concern arises as the EU seeks to reduce its dependence on China for ferronickel and steel production. 

Those that oppose the deal say that regulators need to consider how the acquisition would impact competition between major economies in a rather unstable geopolitical environment.  

Anglo American and MMG argue that there’s plenty of ferronickel availability across the market, and Chinese control wouldn’t affect competition.  

Amid the EU’s review, Anglo American said it would likely close its Brazilian nickel operation if the EU blocks MMG’s acquisition, Reuters reported. 

Anglo American threatens to close Brazilian nickel operation if EU blocks sale to MMG

Ahead of the original long-stop date, MMG offered guarantees to maintain ferronickel supplies to European stainless steel producers aiming to ease the EU’s concerns.  

The antitrust committee decision on the deal is expected to come out by the end of 2026, leaving the companies with about 10 days to decide how to move forward.

items.title: China’s New Tunnel-Boring Export Controls Cast Shadow Over Warming Ties With India
items.author: Rudy Lu
items.creator: Rudy Lu
items.summary: Despite the warming ties between China and India following President Xi Jinping’s visit to New Delhi for the BRICS summit in September, trade frictions and territorial tensions continue to simmer beneath the surface. China announced sweeping new export controls on tunnel-boring machines and other specialized …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
Despite the warming ties between China and India following President Xi Jinping’s visit to New Delhi for the BRICS summit in September, trade frictions and territorial tensions continue to simmer beneath the surface.

China announced sweeping new export controls on tunnel-boring machines and other specialized construction equipment last week, a move Chinese analysts have interpreted as an attempt to restrict India’s strategic infrastructure development, particularly along the countries’ disputed Himalayan border.

The regulations, issued jointly by the Ministry of Commerce and the General Administration of Customs , cover tunnel-boring machines (TBMs), including shield machines and hard-rock tunnel borers, as well as critical components such as cutterheads, main drive systems and remanufacturing technologies. They also extend to specialized walking excavators capable of operating in difficult terrain and concrete-spraying machines used to reinforce tunnels at high altitudes.

The equipment is widely used in civilian infrastructure projects, such as metro systems, high-speed railways, highways, and hydropower facilities. The same machines can also be used to build military transport corridors, strategic tunnels, and other infrastructure supporting troop and equipment movements in mountainous border regions.

Set to take effect on November 18, the rules establish a two-tier export approval system.

Exporters shipping covered equipment to what Beijing describes as “sensitive countries and regions that have disputes with China” must obtain government licenses. Shipments to other destinations are subject to a simpler registration process.

Overseas organizations and individuals are prohibited from transferring or supplying Chinese-origin controlled equipment to sensitive destinations without Beijing’s approval, potentially affecting international contractors that purchase machinery in one country and redeploy it elsewhere.

Beijing has not publicly identified which countries fall under the sensitive-destination category. 

The announcement has raised concerns in India, where major infrastructure projects remain dependent on imported tunneling equipment. According to a 2020 investigation by The Indian Express , industry suppliers estimated that nearly 90 percent of tunnel-boring machines deployed across India had links to China..

India’s Economic Times reported that government officials plan to consult industry stakeholders to mitigate the potential impact . While officials played down the likelihood of widespread delays to highway construction, they acknowledged that shortages of specialized machinery could affect major projects, such as the Mumbai–Ahmedabad high-speed railway, India’s first under-construction high-speed bullet train project.

New Delhi has already begun efforts to reduce its dependence on imported equipment.

Reuters reported in August that India was preparing a $1.2 billion manufacturing incentive program aimed at attracting $1.8 billion in investment over seven years. Tunnel-boring machines are among the priority products.

Li Guangman, a senior researcher at the Kunlunce Research Institute, a leftist, pro-government Chinese think tank, said that restricting tunnel-boring equipment would allow Beijing to constrain India’s construction of military transport networks near the Line of Actual Control, the de facto border separating Indian-controlled territory from Chinese-controlled territory.

Bloomberg reported in August that India is planning to invest $4.7 billion in railway upgrades along its borders with China, Pakistan and Bangladesh over the next two years. Li argued that advanced tunneling machinery could help India build all-weather transport corridors through the Himalayas, allowing troops and military supplies to move more easily across the mountainous frontier. 

The restrictions also come amid renewed territorial friction. India’s Home Ministry announced early this month standardized names for 28 locations and geographical features in Ladakh, including areas disputed with China.

China’s Foreign Ministry firmly opposed the announcement , reiterating that Beijing has never recognized the “so-called Union Territory of Ladakh,” which India had established “unilaterally and illegally.”

items.title: テンセントがオラクルからAI半導体10万個をリース、70億ドル規模－FT
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、東南アジアでオラクルから先端のAI半導体を借り受けることで合意した。テンセントにとってAI半導体のリース契約としては過去最大規模となる。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）が事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、テンセントは、5年間の契約の一環として10万個の半導体を利用できるようになる。契約額は70億ドル（約1兆1000億円）に上るという。

中国のAI開発企業は米国の輸出規制を回避するため、米エヌビディア製など中国国内では入手できないAIアクセラレーターを海外で借りて利用している。中国のテクノロジー企業は、東南アジアのデータセンターの最大顧客層の一つとなっている。

テンセントとオラクルの担当者は、ブルームバーグ・ニュースのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。
